resumen: Rechazado. Pasan las 135 pruebas del constructor y los 27 casos reutilizados en test_ronda2_adaptada_r3.py. Las adaptaciones conservan los valores originales y admiten el rechazo explícito como corrección. La batería test_ronda3.py reproduce 19 fallos, agrupados en R03-01..17. Se incluyen las 21 verificaciones solicitadas; «reproducido» en una verificación cerrada significa que ejecuté y confirmé la corrección. Los informes todavía exageran algunas garantías. Sólo escribí bajo review/out/astra_scratch/.

def test_provenance(tmp_path):
    from tests.test_packet import doc
    from twlab.packet import build_packet
    from twlab.store import RawStore
    from twlab.timeutil import AvailabilityQuality as Q
    r = RawStore(tmp_path).put(source_id='test', dataset='revenue', payload=b'{"revenue":100}', url='u')
    d = doc('v2', r.ingested_at_dt, capture=r, quality=Q.VERIFIED_VERSION, version=2, payload={'revenue':999})
    p = build_packet(packet_id='p', cutoff_at=r.ingested_at_dt, documents=[d], mode='prospective', evidence_class='prospective_registered', captures={r.capture_id:r})
    assert not p.admitted

def test_receipt_binds_prediction(tmp_path):
    from datetime import timedelta
    from tests.test_schema import base
    from twlab.packet import build_packet
    from twlab.store import RawStore
    from twlab.schemas import validate_prediction
    s = RawStore(tmp_path)
    r = s.put(source_id='test', dataset='weather', payload=b'weather:rain=0', url='u')
    s.register_verifier('fixture', lambda rec, receipt: receipt.digest == r.sha256 and receipt.attested_at == r.ingested_at)
    s.attach_receipt(r.capture_id, receipt_id='fixture:r', authority='fixture', digest=r.sha256, attested_at=r.ingested_at)
    cut = r.ingested_at_dt + timedelta(seconds=1)
    end = cut + timedelta(hours=1)
    p = build_packet(packet_id='pkt-1', cutoff_at=cut, deadline_at=end, documents=[], mode='prospective', evidence_class='prospective_registered', captures={})
    o = base(evidence_class='prospective_registered', cutoff_at=cut.isoformat(), issued_at=(cut+timedelta(seconds=1)).isoformat(), deadline_at=end.isoformat(), independent_timestamp_receipt_id='fixture:r')
    o['ranking'][0]['document_ids'] = []
    assert validate_prediction(o, p, sealed_receipts=s.sealed_receipt_ids(not_after=end))

def test_seal_requires_intact_archive(tmp_path):
    import pytest
    from twlab.store import RawStore, IntegrityError
    s = RawStore(tmp_path)
    r = s.put(source_id='s', dataset='d', payload=b'original', url='u')
    s.register_verifier('fixture', lambda rec, receipt: receipt.digest == r.sha256 and receipt.attested_at == r.ingested_at)
    r = s.attach_receipt(r.capture_id, receipt_id='r', authority='fixture', digest=r.sha256, attested_at=r.ingested_at)
    (tmp_path / r.path).write_bytes(b'CHANGED')
    with pytest.raises(IntegrityError):
        s.read(r)
    assert not s.is_sealed(r)

def test_late_archive_is_not_prospective(tmp_path):
    from datetime import datetime, timedelta
    from twlab.timeutil import UTC
    from twlab.store import RawStore
    s = RawStore(tmp_path)
    old = datetime(2020,1,1,tzinfo=UTC)
    r = s.put(source_id='s', dataset='d', payload=b'old-content', url='u')
    s.register_verifier('fixture', lambda rec, receipt: receipt.digest == r.sha256 and receipt.attested_at == old.isoformat())
    r = s.attach_receipt(r.capture_id, receipt_id='r', authority='fixture', digest=r.sha256, attested_at=old.isoformat())
    assert r.ingested_at_dt > old + timedelta(days=1)
    assert not s.is_sealed(r, not_after=old + timedelta(days=1))

def test_valuation_cannot_label_future_state_as_past():
    from datetime import timedelta
    from tests.test_ledger import MON, FRI, FREE, D, ledger
    from twlab.ledger import CorporateAction, LedgerError
    lg = ledger(costs=FREE)
    lg.buy(security_id='A',price=D(100),shares=1000,at=MON,event_id='b')
    lg.apply_corporate_action(CorporateAction('div','A','cash_dividend',MON,per_share_cash=D(1),pay_at=FRI))
    lg.advance_to(FRI)
    try:
        v = lg.valuation(prices={'A':D(100)},at=MON+timedelta(days=1))

def test_old_residual_is_not_new_profit():
    from datetime import timedelta
    from tests.test_ledger import MON, FRI, FREE, D, ledger
    from twlab.ledger import CorporateAction
    from twlab.simulation import enter_basket, exit_basket
    lg = ledger('300000', FREE)
    args = dict(picks=['A'], slots=1, notional_per_slot=D(100000), open_prices={'A':D(100)})
    a = enter_basket(lg, **args, at=MON, week_id='w1')
    lg.apply_corporate_action(CorporateAction('sp','A','split',MON,split_ratio=D('1.1')))
    exit_basket(lg,a,close_prices={'A':D(100)/D('1.1')},at=FRI,week_id='w1')
    assert lg.positions['A'].shares == 100
    b = enter_basket(lg, **args, at=MON+timedelta(days=7), week_id='w2')
    exit_basket(lg,b,close_prices={'A':D(100)},at=FRI+timedelta(days=7),week_id='w2')
    assert b[0].gross_pick_return == D(0)

def test_hours_are_immutable():
    from datetime import date, time
    from tests.test_master import R
    from tests.test_ledger import MON
    from twlab.calendar import TradingCalendar, CalendarStore
    d = date(2026,9,7)
    try:
        c = TradingCalendar(start=date(2026,1,1),end=date(2026,12,31),closures=[],session_overrides={d:[time(9),time(13,30)]},source_id='t',recorded_at=R(2026,1,1))
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return
    s = CalendarStore(); s.add(c)
    before = s.as_known_at(MON).session_open(d)
    try:
        c.session_hours(d)[0] = time(12)
    except TypeError:
        pass
    assert s.as_known_at(MON).session_open(d) == before

def test_preserve_gap_after_closed_segment():

    from tests.test_master import R, sv
    from twlab.master import SecurityMaster

    m.add(sv(security_id='A',symbol='1111',valid_from=date(2020,1,1)))

    try:
        m.change_segment('A',new=sv(security_id='A',symbol='2222',valid_from=date(2023,1,1),recorded_at=R(2023,1,1)),recorded_at=R(2023,1,1),source_id='s')

cambios_del_plan_evaluados.argumento: Acepto exigir captura, digest y transformación reproducible. Mientras no exista el extractor verificado, bloquear la promoción documental correspondiente. source_sha256 declarado no acredita el payload y verified_version ya se admite con derivation=None, contradiciendo la condición anunciada.

La cadena parcial no permite cerrar R02-06/07: el plazo es libre, falta vincular predicción, paquete y bytes archivados, y un identificador de recibo ajeno basta para validar. El adaptador criptográfico pendiente es una limitación declarada; los caminos que ya aceptan evidencia prospectiva deben bloquearse hasta completar y probar la cadena.

Acepto conservar fracciones y cobros sin fecha, y avanzar pagos sin negociar. Exijo fechar el conocimiento de la fecha de pago sin retroactividad, mantener coherentes efectivo y valoración, separar residuos entre selecciones y ejecutar una prueba semanal completa de invalid:no_sessions. La política está parcialmente implementada; el registro semanal anunciado todavía no existe.
